name: Outbreak IO
hook: One bite and you're one of them.
how: A zombie or two rise from the graveyard and every survivor they touch turns too. Survivors win if anyone is still human when the timer runs out; grab speed shoes, decoys, flashbangs and boards around town, and shove zombies back when they get close.
controls: WASD or hold the mouse to run, Space to shove, E to use your item; on touch, drag to run and tap SHOVE or the item button
uses: Each player's best round: seconds survived, bites and a bonus for lasting to the end.
The host's browser decides every bite, pickup, stun and barricade; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bots fill both sides: survivors run and use items, zombies hunt the nearest human.
Every player, zombie, item and boarded-up door is the same for everyone.
ideas: Add a safe house that opens for the last 20 seconds
Give zombies a sprint they can use every 10 seconds
Make it a snowy ski resort with yetis instead of zombies
